title: Concept: Release artifacts are published over cleartext
description: pom.xml declares a `<distributionManagement><repository>` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `<distributionManagement><repository>` URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `<distributionManagement><repository>` URL over cleartext.
